messages:
IncidentBot: PAGER: multiple 5xx spikes reported for edge-proxy in eu-west-1 — paging oncall (severity: P1)
Alex (oncall SRE): on it, pinging infra. seeing elevated 502/504 from ELB -> backend target health oscillating.
Mira (Infra): I see EC2 instance flaps in eu-west-1b, ENI detach logs correlated at 2024-11-18T03:12Z. Could be underlying AZ networking.
Alex (oncall SRE): copying runbook: need quick triage: 1) isolate problematic AZ 2) shift traffic 3) re-register targets 4) contact AWS.
Sam (Support): Customer-facing triage: lots of errors for streaming endpoints, some customers reporting session resets. Any ETA?
Alex (oncall SRE): short: start partial failover to eu-west-2, reduce circuit through eu-west-1b. Will initiate weighted Route53 failover.
Jordan (Prod Eng): we have canary policy for cross-region shift. Prep note: connection draining configured 300s. Want to reduce to 60s for faster cut. Thoughts?
Mira (Infra): do it. reducing ELB connection draining:
```
aws elb modify-load-balancer-attributes --load-balancer-name edge-proxy-eu-west-1 --load-balancer-attributes "{\"ConnectionDraining\":{\"Enabled\":true,\"Timeout\":60}}"
```
Alex (oncall SRE): doing weighted DNS change now to shift 30% -> eu-west-2, 70% stays eu-west-1. TTL change to 30s.
DeployBot: Route53 change applied (change-id: Z3ABCDEF12345) — status: PENDING
Mira (Infra): meanwhile I'm draining targets in eu-west-1b and re-registering healthy ones. Detected a noisy instance: i-0a1b2c3d4e5f. Taking it out of target group.
Alex (oncall SRE): logs from ELB: frequent "503 Service Unavailable" with backend timeout. sample: ``[2024-11-18T03:14:01Z] "GET /v1/stream" 503 - target: i-0a1b2c3d4e5f"``
Sam (Support): telling affected customers: "We're actively mitigating a regional networking disruption in eu-west-1; partial traffic shifted to eu-west-2. We'll update every 15 minutes." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Emily (Customer Success): flagging three enterprise customers with active sessions — PS teams notified, offering elevated support.
Jordan (Prod Eng): quick health-check script to verify cross-region consistency:
```
for endpoint in $(cat endpoints.txt); do curl -sS -D - $endpoint/health | head -n 1; done
```
Alex (oncall SRE): Route53 state change now INSYNC, traffic shift visible in telemetry. Error rate dropped from 12% -> 4% in last 5m. Still seeing sporadic retries.
Mira (Infra): AWS support case opened: 1234567890 — investigating AZ networking fabric in eu-west-1. Notified account team.
DeployBot: CloudWatch alarm summary: ELB 5xx spike resolved in eu-west-2, residual in eu-west-1b.
Alex (oncall SRE): Handoff plan: Mira staying to continue mitigations, I'm going to rest for 30m before formal handoff. Jordan please watch deployments and confirm no rollback triggers.
Jordan (Prod Eng): on watch. no active rollouts.
Sam (Support): Incident message (customer-facing) drafted and approved by Emily. Posting in status page now.
Alex (oncall SRE): Quick mitigation steps done: reduced connection draining, removed noisy target, DNS weighted failover, opened AWS case. Next: ensure stateful session continuity, consider sticky-session TTL.
Mira (Infra): Re-registering replacement targets in eu-west-1a/c, monitoring for ENI detach patterns. If we still see ENI detach -> escalate to AWS network ops.
Alex (oncall SRE): Update: after replacing targets, error rate in eu-west-1 dropped to 1.2%. Looks like majority impact was limited to 1b.
Sam (Support): Customers with limited impact (errors but fallback worked): ~120 orgs. Major-impact customers: 4 orgs with live sessions dropped. Notified account teams.
Emily (Customer Success): Starting outreach for the 4 major customers — offering post-incident call and RCA when available.
Mira (Infra): AWS case update: "Investigating increased ENI detach rates in eu-west-1b possibly related to substrate networking issue." AWS advised to keep failing targets out and wait for their fix.
Alex (oncall SRE): Marking severity down to P2 for now given reduced impact. Will continue to monitor for 2 hours.
Jordan (Prod Eng): small postmortem checklist: capture metrics (ELB 5xx by AZ, ENI detach logs, instance syslogs), note mitigation commands, timeline. I'll create a draft doc.
Alex (oncall SRE): handoff to Mira at 03:40Z — Mira will own until AWS confirms resolution or 06:00Z. I'm reachable for exec escalation.
Mira (Infra): acknowledged, will post updates here and to #oncall-handoff.
DeployBot: Route53 weights restored to normal at 04:35Z after stability observed. change-id: Z3ABCDEF12345 — status: INSYNC
Alex (oncall SRE): final summary for thread (short): root cause: eu-west-1b networking substrate causing ENI detach and target flapping -> ELB returning 5xx. Mitigations: removed noisy targets, reduced drain timeout, weighted Route53 failover to eu-west-2, AWS engaged. Impact: transient elevated 5xx affecting ~120 customers, 4 with dropped sessions. Post-incident actions: runbook update to automate quicker weight shifts, add extra health-checking for ENI detach patterns, schedule RCA with AWS and internal infra.
Emily (Customer Success): posting exec note to impacted customers and coordinating calls.
Sam (Support): closing customer tickets for those only with transient errors. Keeping 4 majors open.
Mira (Infra): AWS: "We deployed fabric patch in eu-west-1b at 04:20Z, monitoring". Seeing no further ENI detach in the last 15m.
Alex (oncall SRE): marking thread resolved in incidents channel at 04:40Z — will file full postmortem in incidents/postmortems. Thanks all. :clap:
